summary: The Doom port runs on a disk root: it refuses without its WAD, draws, plays a demo to its end and records one, and plays its sound through /dev/dsp on HDA and on the SB16

cases.behavior: the Doom port refuses to start without its WAD, draws on the framebuffer with a zone sized from the machine's free memory, plays a demo to its end drawing as it goes, and records a demo through fopen

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes the disk copy, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot the copy to its root shell and look for the WAD
run the game with the WAD moved away, and put it back
start the game in the background, wait for its report of the first frame, look at it and kill it
record a demo until its buffer of 1 KiB fills, and end the machine with QMP's quit

assertions.checks: the disk has /demo/doom1.wad, which its image stages from ports/doom/doom1.wad
the game started with its WAD moved away exits with status 255
that game prints the engine's error that the IWAD was not found
the game started in the background reports its first frame drawn
the game still runs once it has reported its first frame
the game reported the framebuffer's geometry and did not fail to open it
the game's zone is at least 10 MiB, sized from the machine's free memory
demo1 played to its end quits with status 0
the game's last report of the demo counts more than one frame drawn
a demo recorded until its buffer fills is written through fopen with mode 644

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case boots a disk root of its own whose shell is root's on the console, and moves the game's WAD away

cases.behavior: on an Intel HDA controller the Doom port plays demo1 to its end with its effects and music on /dev/dsp, whose queue after each update of the game's sound stays within a tic of samples and seven periods

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes the disk copy, which it keeps after a failure
